span.div:
- Writes go to the nearest regional leader
- Regional leader replicates asynchronously to other regions
- Read-after-write consistency: reads within same region only
Failure handling:
- Regional leader fails → local election (150-300ms downtime)
- Entire region fails → global observer promotes another region
to primary (requires manual or automated quorum override)

span.p:
Global Observer (coordination zone)
- Tracks all leaders
- Detects region failures
- Can trigger cross-region election
- 2 nodes, quorum = 2
